summary: Implemented the Tabs feature (not committed, nothing run). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (click spans appended last, skipped on the zero-width early path) and yields one Text; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved; layout resolver left unchanged because its Edge protocol already has size, min_size, and fraction defaults. Added tests in tests/test_tabs.py and appended bar and opacity tests, a docs reference page, and a sandbox demo with stylesheet. Choices to review: bar position stays a full-list index and is converted to displayed-tab index at render time for duplicate names; letter search applies only to single-character keys; clickable_ranges defaults to {}. Tests were checked by reading only, not executed, and the animation and on_key paths are untested.
